1.d4 e5 2.d5 Bc5 3.e4 Qh4.strategy: Springs the point of the bishop's sortie: the queen attacks e4 and, together with the bishop, f2, where mate is threatened. White has to defend at once, and Black takes the initiative with active pieces.
